decisions.reason: Requesting guidance about a separate copyright process does not change the deferred client-operated KDP upload workflow.
The copyright-process question does not add, remove, or alter required back matter or author-biography content.
Formal copyright-process guidance is independent of the paperback cover design, trim size, and unresolved cover choice.
The question about copyright formalities does not change the paperback publication format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
Copyright-process guidance has no effect on chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The formal copyright-process question does not modify any manuscript copyediting, clarity, or meaning-preservation rule.
Copyright registration guidance is unrelated to chapter-heading punctuation, capitalization, and hierarchy.
The copyright-process inquiry does not alter pagination or table-of-contents update requirements.
The new publishing-guidance topic does not change justified body-text alignment.
The copyright-process question does not affect the deferred paragraph-spacing and page-density requirement.
Formal copyright guidance does not alter chapter-image coverage, placement, reference method, or presentation.
The shared copyright term is incidental: the source concerns whether a separate legal copyright process is required, not the alignment of the manuscript's copyright page.
